response.original_title: The Bridge Back Home: The Sam Harris Story
response.overview: Sam Harris, a Chicago area resident and president emeritus of the Illinois Holocaust Museum and Education Center, survived two Nazi concentration camps. Throughout his life, Sam has faced a conflict shared by many Holocaust survivors: the necessity of telling his story contrasted with the need to move on. How does one balance such vital but devastating memory with the equally important need to live and move forward? Navigating this challenge has been a lifelong journey for Sam. And as the film reveals, he has found a path of strength and purpose.
